family.description: Current production before/after evidence for worker-aware routing. Baseline is the default-constructed tuned decoder at source 40d0d7aff; candidate is source 24db08ef936e9b8eb42d31205d37c30207ba81a0. Both install the same committed coding envelope, use native Rust 1.95 release builds, decode the same recorded f32 flooding normalized-min-sum inputs at factor 0.75 and iteration cap 50 with per-frame syndrome stopping, and check decisions against the existing prepared quality records. The measured steady-state call is the existing tuned-profile arm: pinned workers, prepared decoder state, conversion, route dispatch, decode and extraction. Cells cover both codes at one frame and one full wave on one worker, DVB-T2 at twelve physical workers and NR at twenty-four logical workers. Small whole-call cells include selector overhead; conversion.dispatch_ns is the existing empty-body executor-dispatch diagnostic and is not isolated selector timing. Baseline multicore waves take the lane route; candidate multicore waves take single-frame. No forced selectors or tuning search are used. Pilot outcomes are exploratory. Confirmation uses fresh samples at the protocol pair count and retains the worker policy only if every non-regression cell records pass; every outcome is reported as evaluated. This distinct worker-policy candidate has no prior confirmatory reservation; its first confirmation has six cells, within the fixed bootstrap-tail bound.

effect.rationale: The improvement vocabulary uses the existing ten-percent material threshold, fixed before this pilot; all declared cells have the non-regression objective.
effect.equivalence_rationale: At most five percent whole-call regression is admissible, fixed before this pilot. The canonical freezer stops when pilot resolution reaches this margin; the margin is not widened from observed results.
effect.material_gap_rationale: The family has no comparator-gap cell.

complexity_budget.maintenance_rationale: Worker context and one canonical tuning selector; no kernels or numerical algorithm changes. The budget bounds this implementation and issue-local measurement glue.
